question.text: Under SEBI (Bankers to an Issue) Regulations 1994, for how many years must a banker to an issue maintain its records?

explanation.text: The Logic: Every banker to an issue shall maintain its records, including applications received, monies, refund details, and dividend/interest warrant details, for a minimum period of 8 years. The Trap: 5 years is a record retention period associated with certain other intermediaries. The banker to an issue has a longer retention period of 8 years. Note: NISM Series III-A workbook (page 285) sets the banker-to-an-issue record retention requirement at 8 years.
